# Moby-Dick

[Ishmael](/wiki/entities/ishmael.md) tells the story of a voyage on the whaling ship
Pequod.[^moby-dick] Its captain, [Captain Ahab](/wiki/entities/captain-ahab.md), hunts
the white whale that took his leg, and his [obsession](/wiki/concepts/obsession.md)
rules the voyage.[^moby-dick]

[^moby-dick]: [Moby-Dick](/sources/classics/moby-dick/moby-dick.md)
